name: Mario Live
description: An AI plays Super-Mario-style platformer screens live on the watch: Mario runs, jumps pits and pipes, stomps Goombas and bumps ? blocks, then walks into a fresh screen. Overworld in daylight, underground from 19:00 to 07:00. Big time on top, battery as a mushroom.

steps.script: const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1
project.groups = project.groups || {}; for (const e of project.elements) { if (/ Aod$/.test(e.name) && e.group) project.groups[e.group] = 'Clock AOD' } return 1

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gClock = 'Clock'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Minute Main","Colon Main","Hour Main"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gClock'; n++ } } return n
